name: 5-MeO-isoDMT
summary: 5-MeO-isoDMT, or 5-OMe-isoDMT, also known as 5-methoxy-N,N-dimethylisotryptamine, is a prospective non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and psychoplastogen of the isotryptamine group. It is the isotryptamine analogue of the non-hallucinogenic 6-MeO-DMT and is a positional isomer of the psychedelic 6-MeO-isoDMT.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-isoDMT, or 5-OMe-isoDMT, also known as 5-methoxy-N,N-dimethylisotryptamine, is a prospective non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and psychoplastogen of the isotryptamine group. The drug does not substitute for serotonergic psychedelics in animal drug discrimination tests and does not produce the head-twitch response, a behavioral of psychedelic effects, at any dose.

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied as a possible antidepressant that promotes the growth of nerve connections.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，被當作可能的抗憂鬱藥來研究，作用是促進神經連結生長。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，被当作可能的抗忧郁药来研究，作用是促进神经链接生长。

fact.en: In isotryptamines the side chain hangs from a different carbon of the indole ring. This version switches on the 5-HT2A receptor and promotes the growth of nerve connections in animals without appearing to cause hallucinations.
fact.zh: 在異色胺（isotryptamine）中，側鏈接在吲哚環的另一個碳上。這個版本會活化5-HT2A受體，並在動物身上促進神經連結生長，同時似乎不會引起幻覺。
fact.zhHans: 在异色胺（isotryptamine）中，侧链接在吲哚环的另一个碳上。这个版本会活化5-HT2A受体，并在动物身上促进神经链接生长，同时似乎不会引起幻觉。
